# Prana Dental Miami

> Family, cosmetic and implant dentist in Edgewater, Miami (3050 Biscayne Blvd, Ste 703, Miami, FL 33137), opening Monday, November 16, 2026. Dr. Aakash Rana, DDS. Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8am to 8pm; closed Sunday. Same-day appointments available from opening day; please call or text first. Free first visit: exam, 3D scan and smile preview. (786) 579-0521. English & Spanish. Most major insurance.
